full_name: Mubeen Goolam | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Biological Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow University of Cape Town (South Africa)
bio: Mubeen Goolam is a stem cell biologist whose lab works on developing the first African-specific organoid models of the brain to serve as an accessible model to study neurodevelopmental disorders in a dish. \
